svg.title: Studium architecture
svg.desc: Author-time Python services produce a LessonBundle and typed Learning Workflow Graph. Runtime packages expose sessions through MCP, HTTP, and a file channel to learner clients, while teacher and Observatory surfaces remain review paths.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', serif

svg.text: One course contract, several learner and review paths
drive the same public session contract
REVIEW SURFACES — SEPARATE FROM LEARNER CLIENTS
